name: Flare management and gas recovery
principle: The flare is the plant's last line of pressure protection — but routine flaring is now an emissions and cost target. Flare management splits continuous and routine relief gas from the header with a flare gas recovery compressor and returns it to fuel, meters what is actually flared (ultrasonic or thermal meters on the flare stack), keeps combustion smokeless with staged steam/air assist sized per API 521, and reports volumes and composition to regulators — all with the flare header's back-pressure limits and knock-out provisions preserved as the safety case.

process_steps.name: Relief gas collected in the flare header with knock-out ahead of the tip
Continuous routine gas recovered by compressor back to fuel
True relief flared smokelessly with staged steam/air assist
Flared volume metered, composited and reported
